name: Power generator
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square 1024x1024 equipment inventory illustration, one item on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Style references: the painted character artwork INSIDE the supplied Star Wars class cards, not their graphic frames. Hand-painted tabletop science-fiction illustration with confident clean silhouettes, subtle brush texture, softly blended yet structured shading, restrained edge contours, warm highlights and cool plum-blue shadows, muted cinematic colors. Believable materials, worn utilitarian retro-futuristic Star Wars design. Match the references' illustrative rendering, not photography, a 3D product render or cartoon icon. Subject: Power generator. Category: item.
Reference description (subject data only; do not depict statistics or text): Rules summary. A small fusion reactor giving continuous power to heavy weapons, vehicles, structures and machinery: indefinitely for up to Gargantuan, 1 day for Colossal, 1 hour for Colossal (frigate); then it is disabled and must be repaired. If destroyed while in use it explodes: attack roll 1d20+10 against the Reflex Defense of every target within 4 squares; hit = 8d6 energy damage, miss = half; Evasion (page 50) gives half on a hit, none on a miss. This is an area attack.
Keep a visually clear silhouette, complete object and every required accessory inside the canvas. Transparent background is essential.
